question: Who has replaced Ajit Mohan as the new Indian head of Meta in November 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sandhya Devanathan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Sandhya Devanathan has replaced Ajit Mohan as the new Indian head of **Meta in November 2022.**
 
• She was previously working as the Managing Director of Facebook India and South Asia.
 
• Ankhi Das, who was the former Public Policy Director of Facebook India, resigned in October 2020 after being embroiled in a controversy over alleged bias in her handling of hate speech by BJP leaders.
 
• **Abhijit Bose is the head of WhatsApp India.**
 
• ** Rajiv Aggarwal **is the former CEO of the **Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI).**
 
• Meta is the new name for Facebook, which was officially changed in October 2021 as a part of the company's rebranding strategy to focus on the metaverse.
